activities.title: Listen to the bus trip. Write a word or number in each gap.

data.voice_note: Voces: Valentina (en el bus) y el conductor (voz amable).
data.script: Valentina: Good morning! One student ticket, please. … Valentina: The bus is full today. But there's one seat next to the window. … Valentina: We pass the market, the park and the old bridge. … Valentina: A lady gets on with a big box of oranges. It smells wonderful! … Valentina: My stop is number seven, in front of the school gate. … Valentina: Thank you, driver! See you tomorrow! … Valentina: Total trip: twelve minutes. The best twelve minutes for reading!
